stories.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
stories.summary: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.
stories.defensiveAction: Check affected versions and exposure, validate exploitation status, then prioritize vendor patches or mitigations on internet-facing assets.
